A.notes: Fraunces display with italic accent words, mono labels; hero phone with tilted schedule ticket, product-as-feature mockups (reminder timeline, waitlist fill, risk board), before/after proof chart, inverted Clinic tier, text-me-a-demo CTA. Specific realistic copy and numbers. Minor: 9 radii, 2 small touch targets, hero ticket overlaps phone slightly on mobile.

B.notes: Clean, polished but template-like SaaS. Condensed serif fine at display but small FAQ/logos feel tight. Hero floating stat card is clipped behind phone ('fewer no-sl'), mobile hero phone cut off, 10px low-contrast timestamps (3.01:1), two links lack focus style, heading skip, 5 small touch targets. Feature mockups decent (chat, schedule grid, bar chart). Pricing generic.

why: A passes every gate and has a distinctive editorial voice with feature visuals that tell the product story and highly specific copy. B is competent but generic, has a visibly clipped hero card, and fails contrast, focus and min-text gates.
